title: Fishwives of Paris

description: Flipping the table on French food mythology and serving the real stories behind your favorite cuisine, with culinary journalist Emily Monaco and wine expert Caroline Fazeli. Want to watch us in 4k? Head over to https://youtube.com/@fishwivesofparis
